+const RECENT_IMAGE_PASTE_DEDUPE_MS = 1500
+
+export function imageBlobDedupeKey(blob: Blob, data: Uint8Array): string {
+  // A macOS screenshot can arrive twice as different File/Blob objects, with
+  // different names or lastModified values. Dedupe by content only so the same
+  // clipboard image collapses across those representations.
+  let hash = 2166136261
+
+  for (const byte of data) {
+    hash ^= byte
+    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619) >>> 0
+  }
+
+  return [blob.size, hash.toString(16)].join('|')

discussion_comments.comment_body: This is not byte-identity dedupe: the key contains only size plus a 32-bit hash, so different same-size images can collide and one will be silently suppressed. Please use a collision-resistant digest or compare the retained short-lived bytes.

`parseMacSystemProxy()` emits both lower- and upper-case variables, but this loop only recognizes an inherited value with the exact same spelling. For example, inherited `https_proxy` plus a different system `HTTPS_PROXY` leaves both values non-empty. Resolve precedence case-insensitively by proxy family (or skip all system injection whenever any inherited proxy spelling is set) and add that mixed-case regression test.
